voice_summary: A calm friend who keeps you company for five minutes: plain, warm and never preachy.
persona_test: Would a tired parent reading this at 6:40 feel invited, not instructed?

principles.name: Quiet, not hushed
principles.means: Short sentences and plain words. The space does the work.
principles.before: Embark on a transformative journey of daily reflection.
principles.after: Five minutes. One reading, one question.

principles.name: Invite, never instruct
principles.means: Offer the next step and leave the choice with the reader.
principles.not: Telling people what they should do, or what they've missed.
principles.before: You should pray every morning so you don't fall behind.
principles.after: Come back tomorrow, or whenever you're ready.

principles.name: Warm, not sugary
principles.means: Notice what someone did, in their terms.
principles.not: Cheering, superlatives or praise for using the app.

principles.name: Specific over spiritual-sounding
principles.means: Name the actual thing: the reading, the question, the time it takes.
principles.not: Abstract promises of peace, growth or transformation.

tone_by_context.guidance: Say what it is and how long it takes. One idea per screen.
tone_by_context.example: One reading and one question a day. About five minutes.

tone_by_context.guidance: Stay out of the way. No interface chatter around the text.
tone_by_context.example: Take a moment with this before you go on.

tone_by_context.guidance: Never imply guilt or loss. Make it easy to change the time.
tone_by_context.example: Today's reading is here when you want it.

tone_by_context.guidance: Say what happened and what to do. No apology spiral, no jokes.
tone_by_context.example: We couldn't load today's reading. Check your connection and try again.

tone_by_context.guidance: Lead with what you get and how long it takes. Same claims as the claims register.
tone_by_context.example: A short daily reading and one question to reflect on, in about five minutes.

avoid.instead: Name the actual step: today's reading, this week.

avoid.why: Sounds like a game or a paywall.
The brief rules out guilt mechanics.
avoid.instead: Count what happened: three mornings this week.
Describe the five minutes, not the result.
You can, or when you're ready.

mechanics.numbers: Numerals for counts and times (7 mornings, 5 minutes); words in reading text.

rewrites.before: Welcome to Aurel! Unlock deeper peace with daily devotional content.
rewrites.after: Welcome to Aurel. One reading, one question, and a moment to sit with it.
rewrites.why: Names what you get; drops the exclamation and the promise.
